title: Non-orthogonal latent components via eigendecomposition (theory and demo)

cues.en: This and the next.
cues.zh: 這支影片，以及接下來

cues.en: Several videos are focused on a multivariate analysis technique called generalized eigen decomposition,
cues.zh: 幾支影片，會聚焦於一種多變量分析技術，叫做廣義特徵分解，

cues.en: also called generalized eigenvalue decomposition or abbreviated to GED.
cues.zh: 也叫廣義特徵值分解，縮寫為 GED。

cues.en: It is not the same thing as PCA, which I will also demonstrate in the code demo, although they are
cues.zh: 它與 PCA 不同，程式示範中我也會展示這一點，不過它們

cues.en: somewhat related analyses and they work well hand in hand as you will see in the next video.
cues.zh: 是有些關聯的分析，而且能相輔相成，下一支影片就會看到。

cues.en: So I want to give you a heads up in advance here, because there's going to be quite a bit of linear algebra in the next half dozen slides or so.
cues.zh: 先提醒你，接下來大約六張投影片，會有不少線性代數。

cues.en: If you are not so comfortable with linear algebra, then you don't need to worry about all the math details.
cues.zh: 如果對線性代數不太熟悉，不用擔心所有數學細節。

cues.en: I will tell you the important take home points, and you'll see how to implement this method successfully in code, even if the math doesn't quite click.
cues.zh: 我會告訴你重要重點；即使數學還不太理解，你也會看到如何成功用程式實作這個方法。

cues.en: Let's start with the goal.
cues.zh: 先從目標開始。

cues.en: Imagine these dots represent a data set in two dimensions.
cues.zh: 想像這些點代表二維資料集。

cues.en: Perhaps these two axes here correspond to two MLP neurons.
cues.zh: 這兩個軸也許對應兩個 MLP 神經元。

cues.en: And then this shows the activation values for lots of tokens for those two neurons.
cues.zh: 圖中顯示這兩個神經元對許多 token 的活化值。

cues.en: So each dot would be a token.
cues.zh: 所以，每個點就是一個 token。

cues.en: Now clearly there are two streams of data here.
cues.zh: 這裡很明顯有兩股資料流。

cues.en: So there's something special about these data.
cues.zh: 這些資料有某種特殊之處。

cues.en: And so these green data and these purple data.
cues.zh: 也就是綠色資料與紫色資料。

cues.en: But how do we separate these two sources statistically.
cues.zh: 但統計上，要如何分離這兩個來源？

cues.en: How do we identify them.
cues.zh: 如何辨識它們？

cues.en: Maybe these correspond to two different networks in the model or latent constructs in the for example
cues.zh: 它們也許對應模型中的兩個不同網路，或潛在構念。例如，

cues.en: the MLP layer of the MLP data are thousands of dimensions.
cues.zh: MLP 層的 MLP 資料有數千個維度。

cues.en: But starting with two dimensions is good for building visual intuition.
cues.zh: 不過，先從二維開始，有助於建立視覺直覺。

cues.en: We cannot just draw out 4000 dimensions.
cues.zh: 我們無法直接畫出 4,000 個維度。

cues.en: So let's assume that there are multiple latent sources that get mixed together in the observed activations data.
cues.zh: 所以，假設多個潛在來源混合在一起，形成觀察到的活化資料。

cues.en: And that's what you see here.
cues.zh: 這就是這裡看到的情況。

cues.en: So there are two streams of data.
cues.zh: 有兩股資料流。

cues.en: And we want to know how we can isolate and separate these two sources.
cues.zh: 我們想知道，如何將這兩個來源獨立取出、分離。

cues.en: Now if we apply a linear separation method then the answer is kind of simple.
cues.zh: 如果採用線性分離方法，答案有點簡單。

cues.en: We just take two different linear weighted combinations of the data channels.
cues.zh: 只要對資料通道取兩種不同的線性加權組合。

cues.en: And that will give us two different components.
cues.zh: 就會得到兩個不同成分。

cues.en: Now for these data you can imagine two regression equations, one equation that describes the green dots and another equation that describes the purple dots.
cues.zh: 對這些資料，可以想像兩個迴歸方程式，一個描述綠點，另一個描述紫點。

cues.en: And maybe these correspond to two different categories of tokens like nouns and verbs, for example.
cues.zh: 也許，它們對應兩類不同的 token，例如名詞與動詞。

cues.en: But how do we determine the linear weighted combination of the two variables?
cues.zh: 但要如何決定這兩個變數的線性加權組合？

cues.en: How do we define those weights?
cues.zh: 如何定義那些權重？

cues.en: Obviously, the individual variables themselves are not sufficient because the green data and the purple
cues.zh: 顯然，個別變數本身並不夠，因為綠色和紫色

cues.en: data all project to data variable one, and they all project to data variable two.
cues.zh: 資料都會投影到資料變數一，也都會投影到資料變數二。

cues.en: So we want to define some axes, some linear weighted combination of the two variables that will best
cues.zh: 所以，我們想定義某些軸，也就是兩個變數的某種線性加權組合，來盡可能

cues.en: separate this stream of blue dots from this stream of purple dots.
cues.zh: 分離這股藍點與這股紫點。

cues.en: In fact, this question here, this problem of how to define the weights.
cues.zh: 其實，這個問題，也就是如何定義權重，

cues.en: This is like the single biggest question in machine learning and deep learning.
cues.zh: 幾乎就是機器學習與深度學習中最重要的問題。

cues.en: And for example, gradient descent is a nonlinear technique to answer this question of how to define
cues.zh: 例如，梯度下降就是回答這個問題的一種非線性技術：如何定義

cues.en: the weights such that the weighted combination of different variables optimizes some function or minimizes some loss function.
cues.zh: 權重，讓不同變數的加權組合最佳化某個函數，或最小化某個損失函數。

cues.en: So what I'm going to do now is show you a technique based on linear algebra that also optimizes the
cues.zh: 現在，我要展示一個以線性代數為基礎的方法，同樣是針對某個目標函數

cues.en: weights for some objective function in the case of generalized eigen decomposition.
cues.zh: 最佳化權重。對廣義特徵分解而言，

cues.en: The objective is to come up with a set of weights such that the linear weighted combination of the variables
cues.zh: 目標是找出一組權重，讓變數的線性加權組合

cues.en: maximizes the ratio between two different categories.
cues.zh: 最大化兩個不同類別之間的比值。

cues.en: So the w here corresponds to a vector of weights.
cues.zh: 這裡的 w 對應權重向量。

cues.en: So one number one weight value for each.
cues.zh: 也就是每一個，

cues.en: Let's say MLP neuron and the x and y are activations matrices from the same neurons but for different categories.
cues.zh: 比方說 MLP 神經元，都有一個數字、一個權重值；x 和 y 則是相同神經元在不同類別下的活化矩陣。

cues.en: So for example maybe there are different sentences different tokens different categories of tokens.
cues.zh: 例如，不同句子、不同 token、不同類別的 token。

cues.en: Let's say, for example, that x is activations for sentences about cars and y is activations for sentences about trucks.
cues.zh: 假設 x 是關於汽車句子的活化，y 是關於卡車句子的活化。

cues.en: So now we want to find a weight vector such that the weighted combination of activations from different
cues.zh: 現在，我們要找一個權重向量，讓不同

cues.en: neurons maximally differentiates cars from trucks.
cues.zh: 神經元活化的加權組合，能最大程度區別汽車與卡車。

cues.en: And we could use that to try to identify a distributed component in the language model that prefers
cues.zh: 可以藉此嘗試辨識語言模型中，偏好

cues.en: cars over trucks, while holding constant everything that is similar between cars and trucks, such as.
cues.zh: 汽車而非卡車的分散式成分，同時保持汽車與卡車之間所有相同的部分不變，例如，

cues.en: I don't know the fact that there are both mechanical.
cues.zh: 我不知道，兩者都是機械，

cues.en: They're both forms of transportation.
cues.zh: 也都是交通工具。

cues.en: Now, these vertical lines here and the square term you can interpret as like power or total energy.
cues.zh: 這些直線和平方項，可以理解為功率或總能量。

cues.en: It's the squared vector norm.
cues.zh: 它是向量範數的平方。

cues.en: But it's basically like we are maximizing the variance in the car representation relative to the variance in the truck representation.
cues.zh: 基本上，我們在最大化汽車表徵的變異數，相對於卡車表徵變異數的比值。

cues.en: So now the question is how do we find w.
cues.zh: 現在的問題是，如何找出 w？

cues.en: How do we find the weights such that the weighted combination of activations from different neurons or different dimensions maximally differentiates cars from trucks?
cues.zh: 如何找出權重，讓不同神經元、不同維度活化的加權組合，能最大程度區別汽車與卡車？

cues.en: So we begin by just writing out this quantity as the dot product of this vector matrix product with itself.
cues.zh: 先把這個量寫成這個向量與矩陣乘積，和它本身的內積。

cues.en: That's literally just the definition of the squared norm of a vector.
cues.zh: 這正是向量範數平方的定義。

cues.en: And now we can work through some of the multiplications and the transposes to get this expression here.
cues.zh: 接著，展開一些乘法與轉置，就得到這個式子。

cues.en: And do you recognize this form of the data matrix times its transpose.
cues.zh: 你認得資料矩陣乘上自身轉置的形式嗎？

cues.en: Well that turns out to be the gram matrix of the data, although we actually want it to be mean centered so that it's a covariance matrix.
cues.zh: 那就是資料的 Gram 矩陣，不過其實我們希望先做平均中心化，讓它成為共變異數矩陣。

cues.en: So S and R here refer to covariance matrices of the activations data matrices for the two different categories of tokens.
cues.zh: 這裡的 S 和 R，指的是兩類不同 token 活化資料矩陣的共變異數矩陣。

cues.en: I like to call these matrices S and R, because S is like a signal matrix that you want to maximize,
cues.zh: 我喜歡把它們叫 S 和 R，因為 S 像是想要最大化的訊號矩陣，

cues.en: and R is like a reference matrix to compare against.
cues.zh: R 則像是用來比較的參考矩陣。

cues.en: By the way, if you are familiar with optimization, then you can also conceptualize this equation as
cues.zh: 順帶一提，如果熟悉最佳化，也可以把這個方程式理解為

cues.en: maximizing the quadratic form on f such that the quadratic form on r is constrained to one.
cues.zh: 最大化 f 的二次型，同時將 r 的二次型限制為 1。

cues.en: So that would be a typical way to set up the Lagrange multiplier solution for this kind of problem.
cues.zh: 這是針對這類問題建立拉格朗日乘數解法的典型方式。

cues.en: Okay, so this is a little bit of unpacking from linear algebra, but it doesn't actually tell us how we define the w vector.
cues.zh: 好，這是一些線性代數的展開，但其實還沒告訴我們如何定義 w 向量。

cues.en: It just rewrites the problem into a slightly different form with slightly different letters.
cues.zh: 只是用稍微不同的形式、不同字母重寫問題。

cues.en: So to do that, I'm going to now use some more linear algebra on the next slide.
cues.zh: 接著，下一張投影片會再使用一些線性代數。

cues.en: So here is the objective function rewritten.
cues.zh: 這裡是重寫後的目標函數。

cues.en: We want to find the w that maximizes this ratio, which you can think of as a signal to noise ratio.
cues.zh: 我們要找出使這個比值最大的 w；你可以把它想成訊雜比。

cues.en: The quadratic form on each of these matrices is just a number.
cues.zh: 每個矩陣的二次型，都只是一個數字。

cues.en: So this expression actually boils down to a ratio.
cues.zh: 所以，這個式子其實歸結為一個比值。

cues.en: And that is just one number.
cues.zh: 而那只是一個數字。

cues.en: And we can call that lambda.
cues.zh: 可以把它叫做 lambda。

cues.en: Now I realize this is like a slight abuse of math notation, but the idea that I'm expressing here is
cues.zh: 我知道，這樣有點濫用數學記號，但我想表達的是，

cues.en: that once we find the w that maximizes this ratio, we can call that ratio lambda.
cues.zh: 一旦找到能最大化比值的 w，就可以把那個比值叫做 lambda。

cues.en: So we want to find the w that maximizes lambda.
cues.zh: 所以，要找出使 lambda 最大的 w。

cues.en: And now to find this solution you can set this up as a calculus problem with a Lagrange multiplier.
cues.zh: 要找這個解，可以用拉格朗日乘數把它設為微積分問題。

cues.en: But what I'm going to do is consider not just a single vector of solutions, but an entire matrix of solutions.
cues.zh: 但我要做的是，不只考慮單一解向量，而是整個解矩陣。

cues.en: So we get a matrix W instead of just vector w.
cues.zh: 因此，得到矩陣 W，而不只是向量 w。

cues.en: And that allows us to rewrite this equation with the denominator as the matrix inverse and capital lambda
cues.zh: 這讓我們可以把方程式改寫為分母的矩陣反矩陣，左側是大寫 Lambda，

cues.en: on the left hand side, which is a diagonal matrix of ratios, one for each of the set of weights,
cues.zh: 它是一個比值的對角矩陣，每組權重各有一個比值，

cues.en: so one for each column in W, and after expanding and simplifying the inverse operations, we arrive
cues.zh: 也就是 W 每一欄各有一個。展開、化簡反矩陣運算後，就會得到

cues.en: at this expression here, which is called the generalized eigenvalue equation.
cues.zh: 這個式子，稱為廣義特徵值方程式。

cues.en: If you've taken linear algebra before, then you have certainly seen this equation.
cues.zh: 如果學過線性代數，一定看過這個方程式。

cues.en: Without the R, that would be just the regular eigenvalue equation on matrix S on covariance matrix S.
cues.zh: 拿掉 R，就只是矩陣 S，也就是共變異數矩陣 S 的一般特徵值方程式。

cues.en: And if you've taken my linear algebra course, then you are certainly familiar with this generalized eigenvalue equation.
cues.zh: 如果上過我的線性代數課，你一定很熟悉這個廣義特徵值方程式。

cues.en: Anyway, what does this all mean.
cues.zh: 總之，這一切代表什麼？

cues.en: So this means that to find the weights that optimize this expression here, which means maximally differentiating between, you know, cars versus trucks.
cues.zh: 代表要找出能最佳化這個式子的權重，也就是最大程度區別汽車與卡車，

cues.en: In other words, finding a latent component in the data that best separates activations for cars and trucks.
cues.zh: 換句話說，找出資料中最能分離汽車和卡車活化的潛在成分，

cues.en: All you need to do is perform a generalized eigenvalue decomposition on the covariance matrices of the
cues.zh: 只要對這兩個資料矩陣的共變異數矩陣，進行廣義特徵值

cues.en: two data matrices, and that is a pretty neat result.
cues.zh: 分解即可。這是相當漂亮的結果。

cues.en: By the way, I should mention that if you are very comfortable with linear algebra or the math of optimization, you've probably noticed that I've skipped several steps in here.
cues.zh: 順帶一提，如果你非常熟悉線性代數或最佳化數學，大概已經注意到，我跳過了幾個步驟。

cues.en: My goal in this, and the last slide, was to give you a high level overview of the problem and the solution.
cues.zh: 這張與上一張投影片的目標，是從高層次概述問題和解法。

cues.en: And yeah, this is not like a rigorous proof of this solution or its optimality.
cues.zh: 這並不是對解法或最佳性的嚴謹證明。

cues.en: I certainly did not single handedly invent this method.
cues.zh: 這個方法當然不是我獨力發明的。

cues.en: So if you really want to get into the weeds of generalized eigenvalue decomposition, plenty of other
cues.zh: 如果真的想深入廣義特徵值分解的細節，網路上有很多

cues.en: math heavy sources you can find online, including other of my courses and linear algebra books.
cues.zh: 數學較重的資源，包括我的其他課程與線性代數書籍。

cues.en: I will reference some of these in the next video.
cues.zh: 下一支影片會提供一些參考資料。

cues.en: Anyway, when you think of an eigenvalue decomposition of a covariance matrix, then you might be thinking about principal components analysis.
cues.zh: 總之，想到共變異數矩陣的特徵值分解，你可能會想到主成分分析。

cues.en: And if you're thinking about PCA.
cues.zh: 如果想到 PCA，

cues.en: Then you're probably thinking about orthogonal axes and other limitations of PCA for source separation.
cues.zh: 很可能就會想到正交軸，以及 PCA 在來源分離上的其他限制。

cues.en: In fact, what we are doing here is not a principal component analysis, and therefore the weights vectors
cues.zh: 事實上，這裡做的不是主成分分析，因此 W 中的權重向量

cues.en: in W are not constrained to be orthogonal to each other.
cues.zh: 不受彼此正交的限制。

cues.en: And that's what I'm going to demonstrate in the next slide.
cues.zh: 下一張投影片就要展示這點。

cues.en: And then you'll see this illustrated in the code in a little bit.
cues.zh: 稍後也會在程式碼中看到。

cues.en: Okay.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: So here is this form of the generalized eigenvalue equation as a regular eigenvalue decomposition on
cues.zh: 這是廣義特徵值方程式的一種形式，表示為對

cues.en: the matrix product of R inverse times s.
cues.zh: R 的反矩陣乘上 S 的矩陣乘積，做一般特徵值分解。

cues.en: Now the interesting thing about that is that although R inverse and S are individually symmetric matrices
cues.zh: 有趣的是，雖然 R 的反矩陣和 S 個別都是對稱矩陣，

cues.en: because they are covariance matrices or derived from covariance matrices, the product of two symmetric matrices is itself generally not symmetric.
cues.zh: 因為它們是共變異數矩陣，或由共變異數矩陣導出，但兩個對稱矩陣的乘積，一般而言並不對稱。

cues.en: So that means that the eigenvectors are not going to be orthogonal, because the orthogonality constraint
cues.zh: 所以，特徵向量不會正交，因為 PCA 和一般單矩陣

cues.en: that you get from PCA and from, like regular single matrix Eigendecomposition that orthogonality constraint
cues.zh: 特徵分解中的正交限制，

cues.en: only holds when the matrix is symmetric.
cues.zh: 只在矩陣對稱時成立。

cues.en: Okay.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: There is one more slide of math that I need to introduce you to before getting to the coding demo.
cues.zh: 進入程式示範前，還需要介紹一張數學投影片。

cues.en: So what I've shown you in this and the past couple slides, this is all theory of generalized eigen decomposition.
cues.zh: 這張與前幾張投影片展示的，都是廣義特徵分解的理論。

cues.en: But when it gets to practical implementations, there are some pretty significant numerical issues that
cues.zh: 但實際實作時，有些相當嚴重的數值問題，

cues.en: can make the analysis impossible or give very poor solutions, especially for large data sets like what we have in LMS.
cues.zh: 可能讓分析無法進行，或得到很差的解，尤其是 LLM 這類大型資料集。

cues.en: Fortunately, there is a pretty simple solution which is to regularize the covariance matrices, and it turns out that that will solve a lot of numerical issues.
cues.zh: 幸好，有個相當簡單的解法，就是對共變異數矩陣做正規化，這能解決許多數值問題。

cues.en: Of course, you are highly familiar with the concept of regularization.
cues.zh: 當然，你已經很熟悉正規化的概念。

cues.en: I've talked about regularization a lot in this course.
cues.zh: 這門課已經談過很多次。

cues.en: For example, we have L1 and L2 regularizers.
cues.zh: 例如，L1 與 L2 正規化。

cues.en: In the context of covariance matrices, there are several flavors of regularization, including L1 and L2, but also other ones like Tikhonov and shrinkage.
cues.zh: 在共變異數矩陣的情境中，有幾種正規化方式，包括 L1、L2，以及 Tikhonov、收縮等其他方法。

cues.en: Shrinkage regularization is simple and straightforward.
cues.zh: 收縮正規化簡單直接。

cues.en: It works really well for generalized eigenvalue problems with actual data.
cues.zh: 對實際資料的廣義特徵值問題，效果很好。

cues.en: The idea of shrinkage regularization for GED is that instead of using the covariance matrix R, are.
cues.zh: GED 的收縮正規化概念是，不再直接使用共變異數矩陣 R，

cues.en: We will use a slight modification of R that is shrinkage regularized.
cues.zh: 而是使用經過收縮正規化、稍微修改過的 R。

cues.en: And that looks like this.
cues.zh: 它看起來是這樣。

cues.en: So the shrinkage version of r r tilde is basically a slightly knocked down.

cues.en: Generalized eigen decomposition is a powerful and versatile method.
cues.zh: 廣義特徵分解，是強大而多用途的方法。

cues.en: It is used to identify and isolate patterns that are embedded in multivariate data sets that are otherwise difficult to identify.
cues.zh: 它用來辨識、分離多變量資料集中，原本難以辨識的內嵌模式。

cues.en: It was initially developed by, like the grandfather of statistics, who was Fisher Ronald Fisher,
cues.zh: 它最初由可說是統計學之祖的 Fisher，也就是 Ronald Fisher 發展，

cues.en: and it's been used in, like lots of other applications for over a century.
cues.zh: 而且在許多其他應用中，已經使用超過一個世紀。

cues.en: You've probably, in fact, come across applications that are based on generalized eigendecomposition, even though they don't call it generalized eigendecomposition.
cues.zh: 你很可能遇過以廣義特徵分解為基礎的應用，只是它們不叫廣義特徵分解。

cues.en: For example, if you are familiar with the Fisher discriminant analysis, sometimes also called linear discriminant analysis.
cues.zh: 例如，如果你熟悉 Fisher 判別分析，有時也叫線性判別分析，

cues.en: That is literally just an application of GED, basically exactly the same as I showed earlier in the slides.
cues.zh: 那真的就是 GED 的一種應用，基本上與前面投影片展示的完全相同。

cues.en: I have personally a ton of experience applying and further developing this kind of method in neuroscience
cues.zh: 我個人在神經科學

cues.en: data, and it works really well for multivariate large neuroscience data sets.
cues.zh: 資料中，應用並進一步發展這類方法，有非常多經驗；它很適合大型多變量神經科學資料集。
